# Audio: 00:00.000 => 00:40.734

Transcript
```
WEBVTT

00:00.910 --> 00:03.550
<v Customer 1>Thank you for calling Contoso Support.

00:04.350 --> 00:05.710
<v Agent 1>How can I help?

00:07.390 --> 00:13.070
<v Customer 1>My fictional order 10042 arrived, but one keyboard is missing.

00:14.670 --> 00:16.270
<v Agent 2>I am sorry about that.

00:17.070 --> 00:20.510
<v Customer 1>I confirmed the shipment and will send a replacement today.

00:22.190 --> 00:22.870
<v Unknown 4>Thank you.

00:23.870 --> 00:28.110
<v Customer 1>Please send confirmation to the e-mail already on the sample account.

00:28.910 --> 00:34.110
<v Customer 1>Agent: The replacement case number is CASE-7781.

00:34.830 --> 00:36.270
<v Agent 3>Is there anything else?

00:37.950 --> 00:40.110
<v Customer 1>No, that resolves my issue.
```

Summary.valueString: A customer called Contoso Support about fictional order 10042, reporting a missing keyboard. The agent apologized and arranged a replacement, providing case number CASE-7781. The customer requested confirmation be sent to the email on the sample account and confirmed the issue was resolved.
